categories.name: Person

categories.name: Animal Genus

categories.name: Animal Family
categories.definition: A taxonomic family of animals.

categories.name: Plant Species

categories.name: Plant Genus

categories.definition: A collection of musical recordings released as an album or extended play (EP).
